question: In February 2013 Baauer's Harlem Shake entered the Billboard Hot 100 at number one. What mainly put it there?
options: Radio play after the dance craze
Download sales from a TV advert
A new rule counting YouTube plays
answer: A new rule counting YouTube plays. Billboard began adding YouTube data to the Hot 100 that very week, and plays of thousands of fan-made clips using the track's audio counted towards it. The dance videos did not merely advertise the song; they were its numbers.
move: When a record falls, check first whether the measuring changed.
trap: Assuming the chart counted the same things as the week before.
reference: Billboard, Baauer's Harlem Shake Debuts at No. 1 on Revamped Hot 100, 20 February 2013
